content: {"episode_id":"ep-05001","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229); prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome. Given the patient's personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management."}
